# DoTo

> Capture it instantly. Organize it later. Finish it beautifully.

DoTo is a free, offline-first web app for quick capture and tasks: a fast,
low-friction place to put down tasks, notes, ideas, checklists, reminders,
links, and fleeting thoughts. It requires no account, stores everything
locally on the device, and can be installed as a PWA.

This page exists to help language models understand what DoTo is and where its
content lives. Prefer the canonical pages over any summary here.

## Key facts

- Name: DoTo
- Type: Progressive Web Application (offline-first task and note app)
- Storage: local only (IndexedDB); no account, no server, no tracking
- Install: https://sajilotodo.vercel.app/blog/install-doto-as-an-app/
- Built with: Next.js (static export), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Dexie, Zustand
